name: Refresh

modes.label: Native service
modes.note: Hardware and complete resource tariff unverified.

caveats: Public training gyms for agent RL; sandbox environment sale is plausible, but price and self-serve admission not published in captured pages. Quote-led, no CPU/RAM tariff.
Null values mean unknown, not free/unlimited. No model-token cost, tax or unverified ancillary charge included.
Native browser/device/task/credit prices with unknown CPU/RAM are deliberately non-priceable. Check regime before interpreting any partial resource estimate.
Also offers Trajectories: a model-agnostic computer-use harness inside Harbor with uploaded-job inspection and shareable URLs; no price published.

audit_2026_09_29.source: checked against the provider's live pricing and docs pages

harness_api.quote: The same implementation can run in local Docker environments or scale to infrastructure such as Daytona and Modal.
harness_api.note: computer-1 is an open-source, model-agnostic computer-use harness inside Harbor (Anthropic/Bedrock, Gemini, OpenAI, LiteLLM), run via the Harbor CLI on your own or third-party infra. trajectories.sh is a hosted viewer for uploaded runs ('npx trajectories-sh upload trajectory ./my-run'). There is no first-party API to drive a harness inside a Refresh-hosted sandbox.
